Device.title: Device
Device.description: Registered remote Device Agent with zero-polling state-change telemetry and WebRTC readiness.

deviceUuid.description: Permanent unique identifier of the device agent.

customName.description: Human-readable custom label for the device.

hardwareModel.description: Parsed hardware model name from User-Agent / Client Hints.

isCharging.description: Whether the device battery is currently charging.

screenPreAuthorized.description: Whether the Device Agent has pre-authorized screen capture for the session.

wakeLockActive.description: Whether Wake-Lock and OLED Power-Saver dimmer are active.

uptimeStartedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in ms when the agent session started.

lastStateChangeAt.description: Epoch timestamp in ms of the last state transition or on-demand ping reply.

lastPingLatencyMs.description: Last verified round-trip ping latency in milliseconds.

deviceSecretHash.description: Shared secret hash established during 6-digit pairing.

isLoopback.description: Whether this device is a built-in local loopback simulator.

availableLenses.description: Serialized list of available camera videoinput lenses.

Pairing.title: Pairing
Pairing.description: 5-minute 6-digit onboarding code generated by the Web Controller.

expiresAt.description: Epoch expiration timestamp in ms (createdAt + 5 minutes).

Signal.title: Signal
Signal.description: WebRTC Perfect Negotiation SDP, Trickle ICE, and On-Demand PING/PONG signaling packet.

payload.description: Serialized SDP, ICE candidate, or ping metadata.

GlobalSettings.title: GlobalSettings
GlobalSettings.description: Global security configuration, Master PIN hash, lockout state, active viewer sessions, and 60-item security audit log.

securityLogs.description: Bounded 60-item security and telemetry audit log array.

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Registered remote Device Agents updated strictly on state transitions.

/pairings/{code}.description: 6-digit device onboarding codes valid for 5 minutes.

/signals/{signalId}.description: Ephemeral WebRTC SDP/ICE and on-demand PING/PONG signaling packets.
